interpretation.categorical_ceiling_note: The 1.966 attempt / 0.694 SOG predicted between-team variances are the frozen simulator's measured 2021 forecast dispersion, not a mathematical ceiling over all possible bucket coefficients. A same-fold descriptive projection of observed team means on attack-bucket and opponent-defense-bucket frequencies plus home share explains 16.691 of 18.844 attempt variance and 6.971 of 7.157 SOG variance; 2.152 and 0.186 remain unallocated. This is descriptive-after-selection, not predictive validation. It indicates the 16.877/6.463 frozen forecast gaps are not proven unreachable under categorical features; the fitted rate effects or other model structure may be too weak or misaligned. Within-bucket differences cannot be represented by the current state key. Residuals also include omitted team, schedule, state-path, and Monte Carlo effects; they are not a causal attribution.
interpretation.shared_tempo_note: A common positive multiplier induces positive dependence. The generator uses a total exponential event clock and chooses the shooter by rate share, mathematically equivalent to independent team Poisson clocks; it has no latent common tempo and no fixed total-attempt constraint.
